name: Bear Lake to Emerald Lake
why: A string of three alpine lakes in an hour, Nymph, Dream and Emerald, each closer under the cliffs of Hallett Peak and Flattop Mountain.
book: Timed-entry reservation with the Bear Lake Road in summer (recreation.gov), or the free park shuttle from the Park and Ride.
dangers: Ice on the path from October to June: microspikes.
Afternoon thunderstorms in July and August.

points.name: Bear Lake
points.note: A trailhead lake at 2,880 m at the end of Bear Lake Road.

points.name: Nymph Lake
points.note: A small lake covered in yellow pond lilies in summer.

points.name: Dream Lake
points.note: A long lake with Hallett Peak at its head.

points.name: Emerald Lake
points.note: A green lake in a cirque right under Hallett Peak.
